import sys

def max_average_power(n, k, m, powers):
    # Calculate the initial sum of powers
    total_power = sum(powers)
    
    # Create a max-heap based on the negative values of powers
    max_heap = [-power for power in powers]
    heapq.heapify(max_heap)
    
    # Perform up to m operations
    for _ in range(m):
        # Get the superhero with the highest power (negated back to positive)
        max_power = -heapq.heappop(max_heap)
        
        # If we can increase this superhero's power, do so
        if k > 0:
            max_power += 1
            k -= 1
            total_power += 1
        
        # Push the updated power back into the heap
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, -max_power)
        
        # If we have used all allowed increases for this superhero, remove it
        if k == 0:
            n -= 1
            if n == 0:
                break
    
    # Calculate the maximum average power
    max_average = total_power / n
    
    return max_average

import sys
import heapq

def max_average_power(n, k, m, powers):
    # Calculate the sum of all powers
    total_power = sum(powers)
    
    # Create a max-heap based on the negative values of powers
    max_heap = [-power for power in powers]
    heapq.heapify(max_heap)
    
    # Perform up to m operations
    for _ in range(m):
        # Get the current maximum power (negated back to positive)
        max_power = -heapq.heappop(max_heap)
        
        # If we can increase this power without exceeding k operations
        if k > 0:
            # Increase the power by 1
            max_power += 1
            # Decrease the allowed operations for this power
            k -= 1
            # Push the updated power back into the heap (negated)
            heapq.heappush(max_heap, -max_power)
        else:
            # If we can't increase this power, break out of the loop
            break
    
    # Calculate the new total power after operations
    total_power = -sum(max_heap)
    
    # Calculate and return the maximum average power
    return total_power / n
